    def aging(self, node, p, k, q, delay):
        """Receiver ageing allowance (as) between physical reception and
        application of a message sent at phase p."""
        kk = p + k
        mp = self.mp
        res = self.effn[node][mp[kk - 1]] * (k * self.T - delay)
        if q:
            res += self.pc[node][kk + q] - self.pc[node][kk]
        return res

    def step_info(self, code, p, g):
        """(dst_vertex, cost, age_delta) of an eligible step, else None."""
        if code < 0 or code >= 2 * self.L:
            return None
        l = code >> 1
        n0 = self.n0; n1 = self.n1
        if (code & 1) == 0:
            src = n0[l]; dst = n1[l]; delay = self.dl0[l]; q = self.q0[l]; k = self.k0[l]
        else:
            src = n1[l]; dst = n0[l]; delay = self.dl1[l]; q = self.q1[l]; k = self.k1[l]
        sl = self.slice_of[p]
        ss = self.slice_sets.get(sl)
        if ss is None or l not in ss:
            return None
        rp = self.rho[p]
        if rp < g or rp + delay + g > self.S:
            return None
        bm = self.bmask[l]
        if bm and (bm & self.wmask[p][k]):
            return None
        cost = self.Hc[code] + self.aging(dst, p, k, q, delay)
        return ((p + k + q) % self.P) * self.N + dst, cost, k + q, src
